# unlearning

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:learningUnlearning`](gmeow-learningUnlearning.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/learningUnlearning>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/learning`](../../slices/learning.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A learning event of revision — the agent retires or supersedes previously-held knowledge or skill as it learns. Unlearning is modelled as suppression of the prior state (cognition's [`gmeow:remembers`](../properties/gmeow-remembers.md) withdrawn by [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false), never deletion ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)); this individual names the revision event, not a new deletion construct.
